iko.text: Barrow and Zeph join a gathering of bonders in the wilds, where Barrow, after hearing Lukka and Vivien, becomes convinced that action is needed about the Ozolith.

At the Ozolith, Barrow channels lightning through their bond to blast a great nightmare's head, but the nightmares turn on the hunters, and when Lukka returns transformed claiming to control the monsters, Barrow opposes him, saying Zeph is his partner, not a subordinate.

They flee when Lukka tries to control Zeph, return to Drannith with Jirina and Vivien, and during the siege lead the bonded charge through the main gate to rescue Jirina, turning the tide until Lukka is surrounded.
Afterward Jirina lets bonders and monsters live in the First Ring, and Barrow and Zeph help normalize monsters among people.
